localContext: Evansville anchors the Ohio River Tri-State. CountryMark refines crude at Mount Vernon beside a large SABIC plastics plant, Alcoa smelts aluminum near Newburgh next to Kaiser Aluminum's Warrick rolling mill, and Toyota assembles vehicles in Princeton. Across the river, Henderson County, Kentucky, adds Century Aluminum's Sebree smelter. Coal and gas generating stations, barge yards and river terminals bring more work. Refinery equipment follows API and ASME codes and structural steel AWS, so UT thickness gauging, VT, MT and PT are in steady demand, often on shifts and turnarounds.
certPathwayNote: Employers on both sides of the river certify technicians under their own ASNT SNT-TC-1A written practice; training supplies hours, and the employer certifies. Refinery, smelter and utility owners often add contractor qualification rules that the employer's Level III folds into the program. ASNT central certification is the portable alternative, and Atlantis prepares candidates for it.
